description_en: Creates a host in a dedicated cluster
description_zh: 调用CreateDedicatedHost接口添加专属集群主机
kebab_example: aliyun cddc create-dedicated-host --dedicated-host-group-id 'dhg-6w7q18iwt5jo****' --host-class rds.g6.4xlarge --pay-type prepaid --client-token 'ETnLKlblzczshOTUbOCzSBZH8****' --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-i --vswitch-id 'vsw-bp133c8ifzxd3iv6q****' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDedicatedHost

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination cluster. You can view the ID of the destination cluster on the Clusters page in the ApsaraDB dedicated cluster console.

The database engine of the host must be the same as that of the cluster
parameters.help_zh:
目标集群ID。通过云数据库专属集群控制台集群列表查看目标集群ID。

主机的数据库类型与集群的数据库类型一致
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the host. For more information about the host instance types supported by different database engines, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206343.html
parameters.help_zh: 主机的规格。关于不同数据库类型支持的主机规格，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206343.html
parameters.name: host_class

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the host. Valid value: prepaid (subscription)
parameters.help_zh: 主机的付费类型。取值为prepaid（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription period of the host. Valid values:

<props="china">
Year: Year.
Month: Month.
Week: Week.

</props>

<props="intl">
Year: Year.
Month: Month.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
指定主机的预付费类型。取值：

<props="china">
Year：包年。
Month：包月。
Week：包周。

</props>

<props="intl">
Year：包年。
Month：包月。

</props>
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. Valid values:

<props="china">
If Period is set to Year, valid values of UsedTime are 1 to 5.
If Period is set to Month, valid values of UsedTime are 1 to 9.
If Period is set to Week, valid values of UsedTime are 1, 2, and 3.

</props>

<props="intl">
If Period is set to Year, valid values of UsedTime are 1 to 5.
If Period is set to Month, valid values of UsedTime are 1 to 9.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长。取值：

<props="china">
当参数Period=Year时，UsedTime取值为1~5。
当参数Period=Month时，UsedTime取值为1~9。
当参数Period=Week时，UsedTime取值为1、2、3。

</props>

<props="intl">
当参数Period=Year时，UsedTime取值为1~5。
当参数Period=Month时，UsedTime取值为1~9。

</props>
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 客户端生成该参数值，用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。该参数值只能包含ASCII字符，且不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:
true: Enables auto-renewal.
false: Disables auto-renewal.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费功能。取值：
true：开启。
false：不开启。

不填写默认为false
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The host image. Valid values:
WindowsWithMssqlEntAlwaysonLicense: SQL Server Cluster Edition.
WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense: SQL Server Standard Edition.
WindowsWithMssqlEntLicense: SQL Server Enterprise Edition.
WindowsWithMssqlWebLicense: SQL Server Web Edition.
AliLinux: Other host images.

When you create a SQL Server host, you must specify the host image that corresponds to the SQL Server edition
parameters.help_zh:
主机镜像。取值：
WindowsWithMssqlEntAlwaysonLicense：SQL Server集群版
WindowsWithMssqlStdLicense：SQL Server标准版
WindowsWithMssqlEntLicense：SQL Server企业版
WindowsWithMssqlWebLicense：SQL Server Web版
AliLinux：其他主机镜像

创建SQL Server主机时，需要填写对应版本的主机镜像
parameters.name: image_category

parameters.help_en:
The password of the host. You can set a host password only when the cluster type is private deployment cluster. The password must meet the following requirements:
The password is 8 to 30 characters in length.
The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
Special characters: ()`~!@#$%^&*-_+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
parameters.help_zh:
主机密码。 仅集群类型为私有部署集群时，支持创建主机密码。密码需符合如下要求：
长度为8~30个字符。
必须至少包含三项：大写字母、小写字母、数字和特殊字符。
特殊符号：()\`~!@#$%^&*-_+=|{}[]:;'<>,.?/
parameters.name: os_password

parameters.help_en:
The cloud disk type of the host. This parameter takes effect only for Tair hosts. Valid values:
cloud_essd: PL1 ESSD.
cloud_essd0: PL0 ESSD
parameters.help_zh:
主机磁盘类型，仅针对Tair类型主机生效，当前只支持以下两种类型：
cloud_essd：PL1云盘
cloud_essd0：PL0云盘
parameters.name: host_storage_type

parameters.help_en:
The cloud disk size of the host. This parameter takes effect only for Tair hosts. Unit: GB. Valid values:
512
1024
1536
2048
2560
3072
3584
4096
parameters.help_zh:
主机磁盘大小，仅针对Tair类型主机生效，取值范围是（单位GB）：
512
1024
1536
2048
2560
3072
3584
4096
parameters.name: host_storage

parameters.help_en: The https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198326.html of the cluster where the host resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/214103.html operation to query zone IDs
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID。调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/214103.html接口查询可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch. You can view the vSwitch ID in the VPC console
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟交换机的ID，可通过专有网络控制台查看目标虚拟机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The cluster type for ApsaraDB for MyBase Open Edition. Valid values: onACK and onECS
parameters.help_zh: MyBase 开放版使用，创建开放版集群类型：onACK、onECS
parameters.name: cluster_type

parameters.help_en: The alias of the open cluster. This parameter is used for ApsaraDB for MyBase Open Edition
parameters.help_zh: MyBase开放版使用，开放版集群别名
parameters.name: cluster_alias

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC where the onECS cluster of ApsaraDB for MyBase Open Edition is deployed
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The services associated with the onECS instance of ApsaraDB for MyBase Open Edition
parameters.help_zh: MyBase开放版onECS实例关联的服务
parameters.name: cluster_services

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Default value: false
fields.name: auto_renew

fields.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PrePaid: Subscription.
PostPaid: Pay-as-you-go
fields.help_zh:
付费类型，取值如下：
PrePaid：预付费。
PostPaid：后付费
fields.name: charge_type

fields.help_en: The number of data cloud disks
fields.name: data_disk_count

fields.help_en: The size of the data cloud disk. Unit: GB
fields.name: data_disk_size

fields.help_en: The ID of the deployment set
fields.name: depolyment_set_id

fields.help_en:
The network billing method. Valid values:
PayByBandwidth: Pay-by-bandwidth.
PayByTraffic: Pay-by-traffic
fields.help_zh:
网络计费类型。取值范围：
PayByBandwidth：按固定带宽计费。
PayByTraffic：按使用流量计费
fields.name: internet_charge_type

fields.help_en:
The maximum outbound public bandwidth. Unit: Mbit/s.

Default value: 0. If you set this parameter to a value greater than 0, it triggers the automatic creation of a public IP address
fields.help_zh:
公网出带宽最大值，单位为Mbit/s。

默认值：0。设定为大于0时会自动创建公网IP
fields.name: internet_max_bandwidth_out

fields.help_en: The name of the key pair
fields.name: key_pair_name

fields.help_en: The password of the ECS host
fields.name: password

fields.help_en: The subscription period of the onECS host. This parameter is required when ChargeType is set to PrePaid
fields.help_zh: 购买on ECS主机的包年包月时长。当参数ChargeType取值为PrePaid时，Period参数必填
fields.name: period

fields.help_en: The unit of the subscription period. Default value: Month
fields.help_zh: 包年包月时长的单位，默认为Month（月）
fields.name: period_type

fields.help_en: The security groups to which the instance belongs
fields.name: security_group_ids

fields.help_en: The size of the system cloud disk. Unit: GB
fields.name: system_disk_size
